display.title: Engineering III - Mekanism Factory
display.subtitle: Submit Mekanism-tier machines
description: Tier 3 engineering is Mekanism. Ore multiplication and automation mean the
bulk-metal caps balloon (30000 each), and the factory blocks are worth a lot.
Sample submissions from the T3 table:
- Basic Factory, Purification Chamber, Osmium Compressor - 70-80 each
- Enrichment Chamber, Metallurgic Infuser, Crusher - 50-60 each
- Diamonds & Netherite at premium per-unit rates
Submit Steel Casings and an Enrichment Chamber to bank Mekanism tokens.
The full table reaches ~120% of the 2000-token Tier 4 threshold.
